title: Companion Residence Credit for Rented CondoGuard Units
content:
Underwriting bulletin for the unit rental charge of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy, for a named insured whose own home is insured with the company.

**Rule.** The companion residence multiplier on the rental charge is 0.90 when the named insured's primary residence is insured under an in-force HomeGuard homeowners policy and the CondoGuard policy has been in force for 60 or more whole months since its first inception date, 0.95 when the primary residence is insured under an in-force HomeGuard homeowners policy and the CondoGuard policy has been in force for fewer than 60 whole months, and 1.00 when no in-force HomeGuard homeowners policy insures the named insured's primary residence. The multiplier is applied to the sum of the tier's unit rental annual premium and the landlord liability load, before the full-year rental charge is rounded. Where that sum carries more than one rental multiplier, they are first multiplied together and then applied once to the sum; none of them acts on the result of another.

**Records read.** The customer's HomeGuard Homeowners Policy: whether it is in force and whether its occupancy shows the insured premises as the primary residence. The CondoGuard policy's first inception date, counted in whole months to the day of the endorsement.

| In-force HomeGuard Homeowners Policy on the primary residence | CondoGuard whole months in force since first inception | Companion residence multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 60 or more | 0.90 |
| yes | fewer than 60 | 0.95 |
| no | any | 1.00, no companion adjustment |

## Cases (hypothetical households)

- An in-force HomeGuard policy on the primary residence and a CondoGuard policy in force 60 whole months: 0.90; at 59 whole months: 0.95.
- An in-force HomeGuard policy whose occupancy shows a secondary or seasonal residence, and no HomeGuard policy on the primary residence: 1.00.
- A HomeGuard policy on the primary residence that has expired: no in-force policy insures the primary residence, 1.00.
